flags: Guidebook is the 2021 fifth edition. Cached Wikipedia records Hurricane Helene flooding at Hot Springs on September 27, 2024, but no cached road manager or site operator confirms present conditions. Historical route description and drive time are not reopening or access assurances; no unsupported closure instruction is invented.
No modern byway construction, campaign or designation date is documented. Buncombe Turnpike history concerns the earlier road through Hot Springs, not the whole present NC 209/US 25/70 corridor.

Material strip runs opposite the guidebook itinerary and includes Barnard beyond the guidebook endpoint. Followed the guidebook’s south-to-north order through Trust and Hot Springs to Walnut, without extending the story to Barnard.

Trust chapel recovery account is attributed to NCDOT, not independently verified or presented as a medical conclusion. No current chapel opening or access information is cached. Trust and Betsy’s Gap remain short because supporting detail is limited; gap has no Wikipedia coordinates, so at is omitted.

The current Fines Creek story is supported as folklore, but its closing joke was dropped as unsuitable to a death account. The present Springs temperature and only-known-hot-spring claim are omitted as unnecessary precision supported only by Wikipedia; no current subject is dropped.

Guidebook extraction interleaves columns; evidence uses exact contiguous fragments, with multiple fragments supporting reconstructed sentences. Pages 00 and 01 repeat the same extract; 18 contains a longer extract of the same book.
